service.title: Use of the platform
service.text: Sator may only be used to legally request or provide food delivery services. You must not engage in activity that harms users, restaurants, or the platform.

orders.title: Orders and delivery
orders.text: Order details, delivery times, and availability depend on restaurant information at the time of confirmation. Orders may be changed or cancelled according to restaurant and delivery status policies.

accounts.title: Accounts and information
accounts.text: Users are responsible for keeping account details secure and for providing accurate information. Notify Sator immediately if you suspect unauthorized account use.

payments.title: Payments and fees
payments.text: The product cost, delivery fee, and applicable taxes are displayed before order confirmation. Charges are processed using the selected payment method after the restaurant accepts the order.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.text: Sator works to keep information accurate and the service available, but cannot guarantee that the platform will be free from interruption or error at all times.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.text: We collect account information, order details, and delivery information required to provide the service and improve the user experience.

usage.title: How we use information
usage.text: We use information to process orders, complete payment and delivery, communicate about your account or orders, and improve platform quality.

sharing.title: Information sharing
sharing.text: We share only the minimum required order information with restaurants, delivery drivers, and payment providers needed to deliver and improve the service.

security.title: Data security
security.text: We use administrative and technical safeguards to protect information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, or misuse.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.text: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your information, and manage notification preferences from your account.
